thread:
maya (PM): quick thread — a handful of Dedicated tenants seeing embedding timeouts after the batching tweak. need fast mitigation + backlog plan. cc @aj @tom

aj (Eng): grabbing logs. staging repro: batch>=10 spikes p95. looks like kv-cache/memory pressure.

tom (SRE): log sample: `ERROR embed-svc req=xyz timeout=98s batch_size=16`.

lee (CS): tenant-X reported SLA alerts. they want ETA for a fix.

maya (PM): options: revert (risky), per-tenant cap (fast), or epic for tuning. recommend per-tenant cap + epic. thoughts?

aj (Eng): I can add a feature flag to cap default batch_size per tenant. ~45m PR + canary.

tom (SRE): I'll wire rollout and enable tenant-scoped p95 alerts.

rachel (Design): will draft a short customer comm and suggest a support UI for tenant overrides.

maya (PM): plan: AJ -> PR & canary today; TOM -> infra rollout/monitor; RACHEL -> comms; create RDW-999 "Embeddings robustness" epic. owners assigned.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by @aj at 1788888900. Monitor channel: #incidents-embeddings

aj (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/701 (adds per-tenant cap). requesting review.

tom (SRE): staging QA: batch=16 -> 97s, batch=8 -> 21s. cap=8 safe. approving.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by @aj at 1788888900. Canary in us-west-2.

tom (SRE): canary healthy after 12m. p95 normalized, no timeouts on sample tenants.

lee (CS): tenant-X confirms metrics improved. thanks!

maya (PM): closing — temporary cap rolled; RDW-999 epic created for tuning/kv-cache/quantization. we'll review prioritization in next grooming.

(footnote: root 1788888888, canary 1788888900, last follow-up 1788889025)
